intervals.quote: On 1 January 1988, the Swiss Federal Institute for Reactor Research (EIR) and the Swiss Institute for Nuclear Research (SIN) merged to form the Paul Scherrer Institute, PSI.

operator_text.quote: The ETH Domain comprises the two Federal Institutes of Technology ETH Zurich and EPFL, the four research institutes PSI, WSL, Empa and Eawag, as well as the ETH Board
operator_text.value: Part of the ETH Domain, the group of Swiss federal research institutions that also includes ETH Zurich, EPFL, WSL, Empa and Eawag

summary.plain: Switzerland's largest research institute for natural and engineering sciences, home to one of the world's most powerful proton accelerators. It produces intense beams of muons used in precision searches for new physics.
summary.technical: Swiss multidisciplinary research institute (Villigen/Wurenlingen, Aargau), part of the ETH Domain; formed in 1988 from the merger of EIR and SIN; operates the HIPA ring cyclotron feeding muon and spallation-neutron sources used by MEG/MEG-II and (planned) Mu3e.
